o1:
Enables catalase activity.  
Is involved in the response to oxidative stress; predicted to be involved in hydrogen peroxide catabolic process and response to hydrogen peroxide.  
Predicted to be active in mitochondrion and peroxisome.  
Used to study bacterial infectious disease.  
Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in acatalasia; eye disease (multiple); lung disease (multiple); osteonecrosis; and pseudoxanthoma elasticum.  
Orthologous to human CAT (catalase).
